description: This line plot, titled “Hidden State Mean,” illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers in a neural network model, comparing three distinct conditions: the hidden state mean before the gate, the hidden state mean after the gate, and the hidden state mean of the baseline. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and represents layer indices from approximately 1 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of five (e.g., 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of one unit. The plot contains three lines: the blue dashed line with circular markers represents the “hidden state mean before gate,” starting near 0.2 and increasing to approximately 4.2 by layer 20; the orange dotted line with circular markers represents the “hidden state mean after gate,” starting near 0.05 and rising steadily to about 2.0 by layer 20; and the green solid line with circular markers represents the “hidden state mean of baseline,” starting near 0.04 and increasing gradually to approximately 2.0 by layer 20. All three lines show an overall increasing trend as the layer index increases.
